description.html: The SOBO AL-400P is a slim 7 W LED light for aquariums 40 to 50 cm long. It rests on the aquarium rims on metal brackets, so no lid is needed. According to the packaging, one button switches between three light colors, and the housing is water and moisture resistant.

LED light uses little power and warms the water much less than classic tubes, and the manufacturer states an LED lifetime of over 50,000 hours. The natural white light brings out the colors of fish and plants, while the other modes create a different mood. The lamp is a good choice for smaller aquariums, for example standard 40 or 50 cm tanks.

Switch aquarium lighting on and off at the same times every day, ideally with a timer, so fish and plants have a steady day-night rhythm. Too much light and direct sunlight encourage algae. Wipe limescale and dust off the lamp from time to time, as deposits reduce light output.
